scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: powershell -Command "(Get-ChildItem -Path 'backend-java/src/main/java' -Filter '*.java' -Recurse).FullName | Set-Content 'sources.txt'; cmd /c 'javac -cp backend-java/bin;backend-java/* -d backend-java/bin @sources.txt'; Remove-Item 'sources.txt'"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
